_comment: Read by core helpers/stop-dispatcher.cjs: which Stop checks run, and how each finding reads in ONE line. Each template is a plain sentence for the human who reads the feedback too — no ids, commands or arrows; the agent finds details in the hook's own header. An extract that does not match passes the full text through (nothing is swallowed). Labels and templates are instance language: translate them, keep marker and cmd. mode record = never blocks, writes .claude-state/<marker>.jsonl. onReissue run = the check also judges the re-issue pass (stoppen-gate: a decision re-issued as prose instead of through the question tool).

checks.label: UNFINISHED
checks.extract: markers in code written this turn:\s*([^\n]+)

checks.label: SAME BUG ELSEWHERE
checks.template: {1} changed - does the same defect exist anywhere else?

checks.label: CLOSING QUESTION
checks.template: Closing question "{1}" - if only the operator can decide it, ask it through the question tool

checks.label: OPEN ITEMS
checks.template: The open items from the session start are missing from the first reply

checks.label: QUESTIONS
checks.template: {1} question(s) to the operator still unsettled, e.g. "{2}"

checks.label: CAUSE
checks.extract: reads as a correction or a mishap:\s*"([^"]+)"
checks.template: "{1}" reads as a correction or a mishap, and the reply names no cause - measure it and write the Cause line before the turn ends

checks.label: EMPTY PROMISE
checks.extract: without a mechanism written this turn:\s*([\s\S]+?)\nBuild
checks.template: A promise about future conduct without a mechanism built this turn: {1} - build the gate now or take the promise back

checks.label: DECISIONS
checks.template: Open operator decisions are due now - put them through the question tool, the last question 'continue autonomously?' when a run was on: {1}

checks.label: CLOSE-LOSS
checks.template: The reply releases the operator while something can still be lost: {1} - finish it or withhold the release

_optional_checks_comment: Opt-in per instance, decided with the operator: move an entry into "checks" to switch it on. The dispatcher reads only "checks".

_optional_checks.label: NOT VERIFIED
_optional_checks.extract: finished \("([^"]+)"\) after code changed this turn \(([^)]+)\)
_optional_checks.template: "{1}" after changes to {2} - load verification-before-completion and check first
